challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I am ready to give up the speed of our fully automated deployment pipeline for the next promotion week. We will accept a manual approval step and a slower release cycle to ensure the loyalty basket data has verified consent. In exchange, we get the legal compliance we need to use that data safely. This trade off lets us keep the model improvement on track without risking a regulatory breach. I am not asking to remove the automation entirely, just to pause it for this specific data source until the audit trail is in place.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the speed of the automated pipeline in exchange for legal compliance, which fits the definition of a trade-off.
